props.name: name
props.description: Battery serial / display name, e.g. U7B1LBNL36300660.

props.name: level
props.description: 0-100 charge → derived tone; 'unknown' → SoC-unknown state with a re-map link.

props.name: context
props.description: Set by the flow; drives the Bike/Station indicator + the default caption.

props.name: caption
props.description: Subheading below the image; defaults to 'Re-Map Battery to {Bike|Station}'.

props.name: status
props.description: Flow state; tints the background pattern (grey/blue/yellow/red).

props.name: illustration
props.description: Battery image slot; default themed placeholder (real default: @kijani/illustrations Battery).

props.name: onRemap
props.description: Fired by the re-map link, only in the 'unknown' level state.

states.transitions: status drives the background tint (default→grey, in-progress→info/blue, warning→amber, error→red); level number→derived charge tone, 'unknown'→re-map link.

edgeCases.nullData: caption derives from context when omitted; illustration falls back to a placeholder; onRemap optional (link is static if absent).

a11y.element: View group; battery level is a Badge with text; the re-map link is role=button
aria: decorative illustration + indicator hidden from SR where appropriate
keyboard: Touch only; the re-map link is the sole focusable control

tests: renders name + derived caption from context
renders battery level percent with derived tone
shows re-map link in unknown state and fires onRemap
no re-map link when level is a number

ops.security: name/caption are app strings rendered via <Text>; no markup injection.
